description: Title of the source publication from which the record was extracted.

Digital Object Identifier of the source publication. Most values are given in resolvable URL form (https://doi.org/...); some are in bare 10.x form. A small number of rows carry a source repository URL in place of a DOI where the source has no assigned DOI.
Publication year of the source study.
Location of the data within the source (e.g. specific table, figure, or digitized/text passage) documenting where each value was obtained.
Internal short citation key / reference identifier used during curation to tie the record to its source.
Feedstock / biomass sample name as reported in the source study. 433 distinct identities across the dataset.
Standardized feedstock family label assigned during harmonization (e.g. Softwood, Hardwood, Agricultural residue, Herbaceous, Kraft/technical lignin).
Carbon content of the feedstock (ultimate analysis), dry basis.
Hydrogen content of the feedstock (ultimate analysis), dry basis.
Oxygen content of the feedstock, dry basis. Often obtained by difference (see O_method).
Nitrogen content of the feedstock (ultimate analysis), dry basis.
Sulfur content of the feedstock (ultimate analysis), dry basis.
Ash content of the feedstock, dry basis.
Lignin content of the feedstock, dry basis (structural/lignocellulosic analysis). May be imputed; see Lignin_imputed / Lignin_method.
Cellulose content of the feedstock, dry basis. May be imputed; see cellulose_imputed / cellulose_method.
Hemicellulose content of the feedstock, dry basis. May be imputed; see hemicellulose_imputed / hemicellulose_method.
Extractives content of the feedstock, dry basis (where reported).
Sum of Lignin + Cellulose + Hemicellulose (dry basis); the lignocellulosic (polymer) total used for structural closure checks.
Lignin expressed as a percentage of the lignocellulosic total: Lignin / LCH_total x 100.
Holocellulose (cellulose + hemicellulose) expressed as a percentage of the lignocellulosic total: (Cellulose + Hemicellulose) / LCH_total x 100.
Lignin reconstructed from LCH_total and the learned lignin share (LCH_total x Lignin_share). Present only for records where this reconstruction path was used.
Cellulose reconstructed from LCH features and the family-median cellulose fraction. Present only where this reconstruction path was used.
Hemicellulose reconstructed from LCH features and the family-median hemicellulose fraction. Present only where this reconstruction path was used.
Minimum reported feedstock moisture content, as-received basis (where reported).
Maximum reported feedstock moisture content, as-received basis (where reported).
Oxygen-to-carbon molar ratio of the feedstock (Van Krevelen coordinate).
Hydrogen-to-carbon molar ratio of the feedstock (Van Krevelen coordinate).
Higher heating value of the feedstock, dry basis. Measured where reported; otherwise estimated (see HHV_feedstock_method / HHV_feedstock_imputed).

Lignin Readiness Index, a composite 0-1 indicator of feedstock suitability for lignin-focused conversion. LRI = (Lignin/100 + C/60 + HHV/22 + (1/(O/C))/2 + (1/(H/C))/2) / 6, with conservative lignin-rich scaling and a cap on 1/(O/C).
LRI value after imputation of missing inputs; a softer proxy derived from broadly reported ultimate-analysis and HHV descriptors when the full polymer triplet is unavailable (see LRI_imputed_source).
Sum of Lignin + Cellulose + Hemicellulose (wt% dry) used as a polymer mass-balance closure check.
Sum of C + H + O + N + S + Ash (wt% dry) used as an elemental mass-balance closure check (expected ~100%).
Sum of C + H + O + N + S (wt% dry, ash excluded) used as an elemental closure check.
Categorical quality flag for lignocellulosic closure: OK, LCH>105, LCH>110, or LCH<0, indicating polymer-sum consistency.
High-level process family of the run (Hydrothermal).
Specific process subtype: HTL, HTL_solvothermal, HTC, or APR (aqueous-phase reforming).
Reactor type / configuration reported for the run (e.g. batch autoclave, continuous, micro-reactor).
Initial reactor atmosphere / cover gas (e.g. N2, Ar, air, reducing gas), where reported.
Primary reaction medium or solvent (e.g. water, ethanol, methanol, water-ethanol).
Reaction (holding) temperature. Actual range across the dataset: 20-603 degrees C; typical hydrothermal operating window 200-400 degrees C.
Isothermal residence / holding time at reaction temperature. Actual range 0-2640 min.
Heating / ramp time from ambient to reaction temperature (where reported).
Initial solids concentration (initial concentration) of feedstock in the slurry.
Reaction pressure. Stored as text to accommodate the literal value 'autogenous' as well as numeric MPa values.
Average heating rate to reaction temperature (where reported).
Stirring / agitation speed (where reported).
Water(or solvent)-to-biomass mass ratio.
Catalyst name or system. The literal value 'none' explicitly denotes a non-catalytic run.
Catalyst-to-biomass mass ratio.
Basis on which yields are normalized (e.g. dry feed, dry-ash-free feed, as-received).
Post-reaction phase-separation / work-up method used to isolate product fractions (where reported).
Bio-oil / biocrude yield, wt% of initial dry feedstock.
Char / hydrochar / solid-residue yield, wt% of initial dry feedstock.
Aqueous-phase yield, wt% of initial dry feedstock.
Gas-phase yield, wt% of initial dry feedstock.
Combined gas + water (or gas + loss) yield term reported by studies that do not separate the two.
Energy recovery in the bio-oil fraction, % of initial feedstock chemical energy (yield x HHV_product / HHV_feed).
Energy recovery in the char/solid fraction, % of initial feedstock chemical energy.
Carbon recovery in the bio-oil fraction, % of initial feedstock carbon.
Carbon recovery in the char/solid fraction, % of initial feedstock carbon.
Higher heating value of the bio-oil.
Carbon content of the bio-oil (ultimate analysis).
Hydrogen content of the bio-oil (ultimate analysis).
Oxygen content of the bio-oil (ultimate analysis).
Nitrogen content of the bio-oil (ultimate analysis).
Sulfur content of the bio-oil (ultimate analysis).
Oxygen-to-carbon molar ratio of the bio-oil (Van Krevelen coordinate).
Hydrogen-to-carbon molar ratio of the bio-oil (Van Krevelen coordinate).
Higher heating value of the char / hydrochar.
Carbon content of the char (ultimate analysis).
Hydrogen content of the char (ultimate analysis).
Oxygen content of the char (ultimate analysis).
Nitrogen content of the char (ultimate analysis).
Sulfur content of the char (ultimate analysis).
Oxygen-to-carbon molar ratio of the char (Van Krevelen coordinate).
Hydrogen-to-carbon molar ratio of the char (Van Krevelen coordinate).
Boolean flag: True if the feedstock ash value was adjusted/renormalized during harmonization.
Numeric ash adjustment (wt% dry) applied during harmonization (0 when no adjustment).
Lignin content estimated from feedstock HHV via the linear proxy Lignin = (HHV_feed - 16.8218) / 0.0889, clipped to [5, 60] wt%. Engineered descriptor.
Lignin content estimated from feedstock carbon via Lignin = ((C - 44)/(63 - 44)) x 100, clipped to [5, 60] wt%. Engineered descriptor.
Consensus lignin estimate: element-wise median of Lignin_HHV_est and Lignin_C_est. Engineered proxy used when measured lignin is unavailable.
Holocellulose content (cellulose + hemicellulose), dry basis. Defined directly when both are present, otherwise via mass balance 100 - Ash - Extractives - Lignin (see Holocellulose_source).
Cellulose fraction of holocellulose from mass balance, Ce/(Ce+He); filled by family median where direct values are missing (see CeFrac_mb_source).
Inverse feedstock O/C ratio, 1/(O/C + eps); a deoxygenation-potential descriptor used in engineered feature sets.
Inverse feedstock H/C ratio, 1/(H/C + eps); engineered descriptor.
Inverse-ash descriptor, clip((20 - Ash)/20, 0, 1); higher for low-ash feedstocks. Engineered descriptor.
Feedstock carbon normalized by 60, C/60; engineered scaling used in composite indices.
Feedstock HHV normalized by 22, HHV_feed/22; engineered scaling used in composite indices.
Lignin Potential Index: composite engineered descriptor combining lignin-related estimates (carbon- and HHV-based) into a single lignin-propensity score.
Holocellulose Potential Index: composite engineered descriptor combining holocellulose-related estimates into a single holocellulose-propensity score.
Learned lignin share of the polymer triplet, L/(L+Ce+He), for records with the full triplet; basis for the data-driven readiness indices.
Learned cellulose fraction of holocellulose, Ce/(Ce+He), for records with cellulose+hemicellulose.
Data-driven Lignin Readiness Index, defined as L_share_idx (lignin share of the polymer triplet).
Data-driven Cellulose Readiness Index, (1 - L_share_idx) x CeFrac_idx.
Data-driven Hemicellulose Readiness Index, (1 - L_share_idx) x (1 - CeFrac_idx).
Lignocellulosic total (L+C+H) after imputation of missing values (ML model or family-median fallback; see LCH_total_imputed_source).
Lignin value imputed from the (imputed) LCH total and lignin share (see Lignin_imputed_from_LCH_source).
Cellulose value imputed from the (imputed) LCH total and cellulose fraction (see cellulose_imputed_from_LCH_source).
Hemicellulose value imputed from the (imputed) LCH total and hemicellulose fraction (see hemicellulose_imputed_from_LCH_source).
Data-driven cellulose fraction of holocellulose, CeRI_dd/(CeRI_dd + HeRI_dd) (0.5 when undefined).
Data-driven Holocellulose Readiness Index from a chemistry-only proxy formula, with global-median fallback (see HRI_dd_source).
Data-driven Cellulose Readiness Index (composite), HRI_dd x CeFrac_dd.
Data-driven composite Hemicellulose Readiness Index, HRI_dd x (1 - CeFrac_dd).
Free-text curator note on the feedstock carbon value (e.g. basis, source caveat). Populated only where a note applies.
Provenance/method for the feedstock carbon value (e.g. measured/reported, calculated, imputed).
Free-text curator note on the feedstock oxygen value. Populated only where a note applies.
Provenance/method for the feedstock oxygen value; commonly 'by difference' when oxygen was not directly measured.
Free-text curator note on the feedstock O/C ratio. Populated only where a note applies.
Provenance/method for the feedstock O/C ratio (measured vs. calculated from C and O).
Free-text curator note on the feedstock H/C ratio. Populated only where a note applies.
Provenance/method for the feedstock H/C ratio (measured vs. calculated from C and H).
Free-text curator note on the residence/ramp-time interpretation for the run.
Method for the feedstock HHV: measured/reported, or estimated via the Channiwala-Parikh correlation from ultimate analysis.
Boolean flag: True if the feedstock HHV was estimated/imputed rather than experimentally reported.
Method for the bio-oil HHV (measured/reported vs. estimated), where available.
Method for the char/hydrochar HHV (measured/reported vs. estimated), where available.
Provenance/method for the feedstock sulfur value (measured vs. imputed).
Provenance/method for the bio-oil sulfur value.
Provenance/method for the char sulfur value.
Provenance/method for the feedstock lignin value (e.g. reported, mass-balance, imputed).
Boolean flag: True if the feedstock lignin value was imputed.
Provenance/method for the feedstock cellulose value.
Boolean flag: True if the feedstock cellulose value was imputed.
Provenance/method for the feedstock hemicellulose value.
Boolean flag: True if the feedstock hemicellulose value was imputed.
Boolean flag: True if the feedstock nitrogen value was imputed.
Provenance/method for the feedstock nitrogen value (measured vs. imputed).
Provenance/method for the feedstock ash value (measured vs. imputed).
Boolean flag: True if the feedstock ash value was imputed.
Source/method of the imputed LRI (e.g. formula, ML_RF, median_family).
Derivation tag for Holocellulose (e.g. 'def:cellulose+hemicellulose' or 'mb:100-Ash-Extractives-Lignin').
Derivation tag for CeFrac_mb (e.g. 'def:Ce/(Ce+He)' or family-median fill).
Derivation tag for L_share_idx (learned vs. fallback).
Derivation tag for CeFrac_idx (learned vs. fallback).
Derivation tag for LRI_dd.
Derivation tag for CeRI_dd.
Derivation tag for HeRI_dd.
Source/method of the imputed LCH total (e.g. ML_RF, median_family).
Derivation tag for Lignin_imputed_from_LCH.
Derivation tag for cellulose_imputed_from_LCH.
Derivation tag for hemicellulose_imputed_from_LCH.
Derivation tag for CeFrac_dd (e.g. 'derived:CeRI_dd/(CeRI_dd+HeRI_dd)').
Derivation tag for HRI_dd (e.g. 'formula:chem_proxy' or 'fallback:global_median').
Derivation tag for CRI_dd (e.g. 'derived:HRI_dd*CeFrac_dd').
Derivation tag for HeRI_comp_dd (e.g. 'derived:HRI_dd*(1-CeFrac_dd)').
